scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test: npm run build && echo 'Running comprehensive function tests...' && mocha --require ./test/setup.js 'test/**/*.test.js' --timeout 5000
scripts.test:exports: npm run build && echo 'Testing function exports...' && mocha --require ./test/setup.js test/index.test.js --timeout 5000
scripts.test:utils: npm run build && echo 'Testing utility functions...' && mocha --require ./test/setup.js test/payment/utils.test.js --timeout 5000
